احتجبن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَبْنَ (iḥtajabna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# اِحْتَجِبْنَ (iḥtajibna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
